spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

** ¶1:** There exists a perpet ual infl ux into the external natural mind of a person . Within it are inn umerable discrete impress ions of truth sealed upon the understanding, and corresponding to these , inn umerable governing aff ections that rule over those states. These are progress ively pur ified of falsity and evil, and are received into the interior mind — by the out ward perception of divine truth, by the Divine Word itself, and by that deep interior still ness which is the peace of the will when the activity of the self hood ce ases and the Divine Love, which is the Father , flows in without obst ruction.

**¶2:** Furthermore , the full ness of dominant persu asions rooted in spiritual darkness — those governing falsities which belong entirely to evil — shall be cast out from the interiors of the mind into the exteriors, into states of va station where they w ander without any ground of good and pass through successive states of dissolution . Some among these falsities are entirely diss ipated through this process of progressive va station. Others, however, are brought back — which is to say, certain states must be revisited and underg one again, because the ev ils from which they arose have not yet been fully separated from the will .

---

*A brief note: * The term ** transm igration** in the natural text res ists simple one -to -one rendering . In the oldest teaching layer it carries the sense of me tempsychosis — passage of life through successive forms . In spiritual correspondence , I read it as ** va station**: the successive str ipping away of external states through which falsities from evil are progress ively removed from the regener ating mind, passing as it were from form to form until they are either entirely dissolved or must be confront ed again.
